symptom: my TCS34725 RGB color sensor won't initialize. The Adafruit example uses address 0x29 but my code uses the 0x39 default from a different breakout and throws 'no device'.

files.color.py:
import board, busio
from adafruit_tcs34725 import TCS34725
i2c = busio.I2C(board.SCL, board.SDA)
sensor = TCS34725(i2c)
print(sensor.color_rgb_bytes)

gold.diagnosis: i2cdetect shows the TCS34725 at 0x29 (41). The TCS34725 has a fixed address of 0x29, but some example code defaults to 0x39 (a different breakout variant). Pass address=0x29.
